posts.title: Trying to Trim my Daily Carry
posts.description: I go almost everywhere under my own power. I carry tons and tons of shit. These two things do not mix well together. I’m taking a lot right now at all of the stuff I carry with me most days, my “edc” to use the reddit term, and paring it down to the base essentials. I’m doing this hand in hand with a much more extensive paring down of all the other stuff I own, I think the two go well together. Li
